title: A pH-dependent microkinetic modeling guided synthesis of porous dual-atom catalysts for efficient oxygen reduction in Zn–air batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,4949-4961
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE00215J, Paper

Tingting Li, Di Zhang, Yun Zhang, Danli Yang, Runxin Li, Fuyun Yu, Kengqiang Zhong, Xiaozhi Su, Tianwei Song, Long Jiao, Hai-Long Jiang, Guo-Ping Sheng, Jie Xu, Hao Li, Zhen-Yu Wu
Guided by the pH-field microkinetic model, we developed an porous Fe1Co1–N–C ORR catalyst, which exhibited excellent performance in zinc–air batteries and provided insights for advanced catalysts.
